showTipsClickCount.title: Clicks before notification is shown
showTipsClickCount.description: Show a notification every Nth mouse click on an action that has a keyboard shortcut (1 = every click).

proposeToCreateShortcutCount.title: Invocations before suggesting a new shortcut (0 = never)
proposeToCreateShortcutCount.description: Suggest creating a shortcut after clicking an action without a shortcut N times. Set to 0 to disable.

hardMode.title: Enable Hard Mode
hardMode.description: Show a blocking confirmation dialog instead of a non-intrusive notification balloon when a shortcut is missed.

menusEnabled.title: Menu Actions
menusEnabled.description: Show shortcut tips when invoking actions from the main menu.

toolbarButtonsEnabled.title: Toolbar Buttons
toolbarButtonsEnabled.description: Show shortcut tips when clicking toolbar buttons.

contextMenuEnabled.title: Popup / Context Menu Items
contextMenuEnabled.description: Show shortcut tips when invoking actions from right-click context menus.

searchEnabled.title: Search Everywhere / Find Action
searchEnabled.description: Show shortcut tips when running actions from Search Everywhere or Find Action.

otherButtonsEnabled.title: Tool Window & Other Buttons
otherButtonsEnabled.description: Show shortcut tips for other UI triggers such as tool window buttons.
